team.philosophyText: The club's coaches work to one simple idea: tennis is learnt by playing. Plenty of balls hit, short explanations, patience and one clear goal for every session. With children, play stays the main way of learning; with adults, every hour on court should be both enjoyable and useful.

rental.campaignTitle: The lowest price in Bucharest this winter
rental.campaignText: Your love of tennis does not take a break in the cold season. At Clubul Tenis Elite we have launched a special winter campaign to keep you training: book a clay court at the unbeatable price of just 60 RON an hour.
rental.campaignPoint1: **Book fast:** choose the day, confirm the time and enjoy your game!
rental.campaignPoint2: **Note:** this offer is valid throughout the winter season.

facts.yearsText: We have worked with schools and kindergartens in Bucharest and Ilfov for more than ten years.
